exposure: body mass index (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obese)
gestational weight gain (below vs. above IOM guidelines)
outcome: caesarean section due to failure to progress
cohort: 704 women with low-risk singleton pregnancy without pre-existing diabetes or hypertension
finding: Gestational weight gain not achieving the IOM recommendations has been found to be associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes in Singaporean women.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section due to failure to progress or cephalopelvic disproportion.
